asins.title: ASINs
asins.description: Amazon ASINs to analyse. Full product URLs are accepted too — the ASIN is extracted from them.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon domain to query. Only amazon.com and amazon.ca were verified during development; other domains need a residential proxy in that country and may return localized aspect names.

emitAspectRows.title: Emit one row per aspect
emitAspectRows.description: Adds a row per aspect (sentiment, mentions, rank, share) alongside the product summary row, so the dataset can be sorted and filtered by sentiment directly.

contentGapsOnly.title: Content gaps only
contentGapsOnly.description: Return only the negative and mixed aspects — the complaints and split opinions a listing has not addressed. This is the shortlist for FAQ and SEO copy.

minMentions.title: Minimum mentions
minMentions.description: Drop aspects mentioned fewer than this many times. Aspects whose count Amazon did not publish are always kept.

emptyInsightRetries.title: Retries when the insight widget is missing
emptyInsightRetries.description: Amazon withholds the "Customers say" widget from some proxy exit IPs and serves an otherwise complete product page. When a product with at least 100 ratings comes back with no widget, the actor rotates to a fresh exit IP and looks again, up to this many times. Set to 0 to accept the first answer and keep the request count down. Products with few ratings are never retried — for them, no widget is the true answer.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between products (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Pacing between product pages. Amazon bot-walls fast anonymous crawling.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is strongly recommended — Amazon blocks datacentre IPs on product pages within a few requests.
